limits: Serialized volatile memory adapter; no durable transaction/conflict/crash/reopen/receipt acceptance.
Cursors are bounded opaque process-local handles; restart, another engine instance or generation rejects them.
Continuation source inventories scan and independently enumerate source facts; witness row/byte/scanned-key budgets are separate from tree/authority work.
Rebuild uses the same prepared catalog and preserves shared authoritative sources; definition migration, online catch-up and changed generated source inventory remain deferred.
Lifecycle methods maintain active namespaces; raw privileged adapter writes can bypass them.
Fixture policy is not authentication; session/restore fencing and credentials remain later gates.
Logical staged/publication/read byte charges do not bound eager cloning, heap allocation or transport bytes.
Recorded skew/tie/rejection workload is a small fixture on this runtime, not production capacity or a whole-transaction logarithmic claim.

dataset.equalKeys: three groups with constant second component

workload.latencyScope: Mutation attempts; subsequent reads, source witnesses and independent validation excluded from per-attempt latency.
measurementLimits: Serialized volatile adapter; prefix scans enumerate physical keys.
Node visits describe measured window reads; mutation KV gets also include routing, validation and tree maintenance.
Attempted bytes sum every logical staged set key/value and delete key, including rolled-back validation attempts; publication bytes encode the final adapter change list.
Byte charges are logical encoded bytes after eager adapter reads; they do not bound heap allocation.
